xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2882: Pipeline membership has no GitLab merged-MR oracle — squash-merged GitLab branches show as unmerged (false planned_backlog rows, mislabeled post_merge_limbo)

plan.title: GitLab merged/open-MR oracle for pipeline membership
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

references.label: PAN-3215 (sibling — DoD gate surface, NonGoal here)

narratives.Problem: For GitLab projects every forge-dependent lens in gatherProjectLensSignals() is gated on project.github_repo, so hasOpenPr and hasMergedPr are always false. GitLab squash-merges leave stale branch tips off main's ancestry, so the git L2 lens keeps reporting them unmerged and only the (dead) L1-merged oracle could override it. Operator-verified live 2026-07-28 (flywheel RUN-73): MIN-896 (MR merged) showed planned_backlog, MIN-908 (MR merged) showed post_merge_limbo mislabeled 'landed via a non-PR path', MIN-864 (MR open) showed planned_backlog 'no PR' — and zombie_pr is unreachable for GitLab projects.
narratives.Proposal: Add a glab-backed GitLab MR lens: (1) new module src/lib/gitlab-merge-requests.ts with listOpenGitLabMergeRequests(repoPath) and listGitLabMergedMergeRequestHeads(repoPath, heads), shelling glab with cwd in the repo (project identity from the git remote), TTL-cached and concurrency-limited; (2) per-repo forge on projectRepositories() via the existing getRepoForge; (3) wire open MRs into hasOpenPr and merged-MR heads into hasMergedPr behind the forge-capability split (no github_repo + >=1 gitlab-forge repo), with polyrepo union semantics — a head merged in ANY gitlab-forge repo counts; (4) glab failures surface as forge_unavailable; (5) update docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- DoD gate verify-merged GitLab/monorepo gaps (verifySquashMergedPrByBranch is GitHub-only; verifyConventionBranchMerged runs git in ctx.projectPath) — filed as PAN-3215.
- No GitLab equivalent of listIssueStatesBatched — the tracker lens already supplies complete issue state for GitLab projects.
- No head-sha matching in the gather — parity with the GitHub oracle (branch-name match); finer per-head-sha verdicts stay with merge-completeness.ts.
- No raw GitLab REST/token client — glab CLI only, consistent with src/lib/forge.ts.
- No changes for projects with github_repo set — the GitHub path is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- No changes to resolvePipelineMembership bucket semantics — the lenses feed the existing resolver unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: glab CLI (cwd-scoped, project from git remote) instead of raw REST+token
autoDecisions.rationale: Every existing GitLab call in the codebase (src/lib/forge.ts:176,291) uses glab; auth/host incl. self-hosted resolve from glab config and the remote — no new auth surface. Verified live: glab auth status OK, both query shapes return correct MYN data.

autoDecisions.summary: Per-head exact merged-MR queries, not a paginated full snapshot
autoDecisions.rationale: GitLab REST filters source_branch one at a time; a capped snapshot silently drops old merges — exactly the false-planned_backlog failure being fixed. Per-head is exact; cost bounded by open candidates, TTL cache, concurrency limit.

autoDecisions.summary: GitHub path wins when github_repo is set; GitLab path only with no github_repo and >=1 gitlab-forge repo
autoDecisions.rationale: Zero regression risk for GitHub projects; the split mirrors the capability gating PAN-2877 established.

autoDecisions.summary: Polyrepo union across all gitlab-forge repos without per-issue merge-set resolution
autoDecisions.rationale: The gather is project-wide; a merged MR named feature/<id> in any project repo is sound evidence the issue landed (issue body's own fix direction).

autoDecisions.summary: DoD gate GitLab gap filed as sibling PAN-3215, NonGoal here
autoDecisions.rationale: Different surface (per-issue, not batched) with its own GitHub-only oracle and monorepo assumption; the issue's scope is the membership gather.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope widened to include the open-MR lens (L1_openPr)
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's RUN-73 tick-2 comment on the issue authoritatively widened scope: MIN-864's open MR was reported as 'no PR' and zombie_pr is unreachable for GitLab.

items.title: Expose per-repo forge on projectRepositories()

narrative.Action: Export getRepoForge from src/lib/project-repos.ts (currently module-private at line 52). Extend ProjectRepository (src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts:314-317) with `forge: ForgeType` and `repoKey?: string`. In projectRepositories() (line 331): monorepo path sets forge = inferProjectForgeSync(project) || 'github'; polyrepo path sets forge = getRepoForge(repo, project) and repoKey = repo.name per workspace.repos[] entry. gatherIssueBranchContainment consumes the same objects additively — no behavior change. Add a unit test: polyrepo config with gitlab_repo set + one `remote: github` entry yields forge 'github' for that repo and 'gitlab' for the default entries; monorepo with only gitlab_repo yields 'gitlab'.

items.title: Given a polyrepo ProjectConfig with gitlab_repo set and one workspace.repos[] entry carrying remote: 'github', when projectRepositories() runs, then that entry returns forge 'github' and the remaining entries return forge 'gitlab'
Given a monorepo ProjectConfig with gitlab_repo set and no github_repo, when projectRepositories() runs, then the single repository returns forge 'gitlab'
gatherIssueBranchContainment produces identical output before and after the change for the existing test fixtures (additive field only)
Create glab-backed GitLab MR helpers in src/lib/gitlab-merge-requests.ts

expected_outputs: all module tests pass with the injectable runner (no real glab)

narrative.Action: New module src/lib/gitlab-merge-requests.ts exporting GitLabMergeRequestRow { iid?, title?, web_url?, state?, source_branch, target_branch?, sha?, draft? } and two functions with an injectable runner (args, cwd) => Promise<string> defaulting to a glab execFileAsync runner (timeout 30_000, maxBuffer 16 MiB — async only, NFR-1): (1) listOpenGitLabMergeRequests(repoPath) runs `glab mr list --output json --per-page 100 --page N` with cwd=repoPath, looping pages until a short page (<100); result cached 30s per repoPath via createSettledTtlPromiseCache (src/lib/concurrency.ts:53), mirroring OPEN_PR_CACHE_TTL_MS. (2) listGitLabMergedMergeRequestHeads(repoPath, heads) returns the subset of heads with >=1 merged MR: per head run `glab mr list --merged --source-branch <head> --output json --per-page 100 --page N` (same page loop), fan out via withConcurrencyLimitPromise (src/lib/concurrency.ts:3, limit 5), cache per (repoPath, head) 30s. Empty stdout parses as [] (pattern from src/lib/forge.ts:307); glab non-zero exit propagates. Tests (new tests/unit/lib/gitlab-merge-requests.test.ts) use the injectable runner — never real glab — and vi.useFakeTimers() for cache tests (NFR-4): exact argv construction, JSON parse, page loop terminates on short and empty pages, empty stdout -> [], error propagation, TTL dedup of concurrent and repeat loads.

items.title: listOpenGitLabMergeRequests invokes the runner with argv ['mr','list','--output','json','--per-page','100',...] and cwd=repoPath, and returns parsed rows including source_branch and web_url
listGitLabMergedMergeRequestHeads invokes the runner with argv containing '--merged' and '--source-branch <head>' per head, and returns exactly the heads whose query produced >=1 row
Both functions request page N+1 when a page returns exactly 100 rows and stop on a short or empty page, concatenating all pages
Given empty stdout from the runner, then the function returns [], and given a rejecting runner, then the function rejects with the runner's error

Given a completed first call, when a second call arrives within 30s (fake timers), then the cache returns the cached result without re-invoking the runner, and when the clock advances past the TTL, then the next call re-invokes the runner
Wire GitLab open MRs into the gather's hasOpenPr lens

expected_outputs: all pre-existing gather tests pass unmodified except the updated non-GitHub polyrepo fixture

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts: (1) add `listOpenMergeRequests(repoPath: string): Promise<GitLabMergeRequestRow[]>` to PipelineMembershipGatherDeps (line 271), defaulting to listOpenGitLabMergeRequests. (2) In gatherProjectLensSignals, compute gitlabRepos = repositories.filter(r => r.forge === 'gitlab'). (3) When !(owner && repo) && gitlabRepos.length > 0, the openPrs element of the Promise.all (lines 536-538) instead fans out per gitlab repo: withUnavailableReason('forge_unavailable', () => Promise.all(gitlabRepos.map(r => deps.listOpenMergeRequests(r.path)))) then flatten to PullRequestRow[] with headRefName = source_branch, headRepoFullName parsed from web_url (path between host and '/-/', e.g. eltmon/mind-your-now), number/title/url/state/isDraft/baseRefName mapped from the MR. (4) Restructure the fork-filter at line 578 from `if (!owner || !repo || pr.headRepoFullName.toLowerCase() !== ...) continue;` to `if (owner && repo && pr.headRepoFullName.toLowerCase() !== (owner + '/' + repo).toLowerCase()) continue;` so GitLab rows (already project-scoped by the per-repo query) pass while GitHub fork PRs are still dropped — the existing fork test at line 624 must stay green unmodified. Tests: open MR on feature/min-864 yields hasOpenPr true and candidate added (resolvePipelineMembership -> in_flight for open issue); closed issue + open MR -> zombie_pr; MR with non-convention source branch ignored; rejecting dep -> forge_unavailable. Update the non-GitHub polyrepo test (line 541) to inject the new deps (its listOpenPullRequests/listMergedPullRequestHeads not-called assertions stay).

items.title: Given a GitLab polyrepo project whose open-MR dep returns an MR with source_branch 'feature/min-864', when gatherProjectLensSignals runs, then MIN-864 appears with hasOpenPr: true and resolvePipelineMembership classifies an open MIN-864 as in_flight
Given a closed issue whose convention branch has an open GitLab MR, when the resolver classifies the gathered signals, then it produces bucket zombie_pr
The pre-existing GitHub fork-filter test ('ignores foreign refs, specs, and fork pull requests') passes without modification
When the injected listOpenMergeRequests dep rejects, gatherProjectLensSignals rejects with reason 'forge_unavailable'
Wire GitLab merged-MR heads into the gather's hasMergedPr oracle

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts: (1) add `listMergedMergeRequestHeads(repoPath: string, heads: string[]): Promise<string[]>` to PipelineMembershipGatherDeps, defaulting to listGitLabMergedMergeRequestHeads. (2) Lift the open-candidate/candidate-heads computation (lines 637-642) out of the GitHub-only block so both forge paths share it. GitHub projects: unchanged call to deps.listMergedPullRequestHeads. When !(owner && repo) && gitlabRepos.length > 0: for each gitlab-forge repo call deps.listMergedMergeRequestHeads(repo.path, candidateHeads) under withUnavailableReason('forge_unavailable', ...); union all returned heads into mergedHeads; the existing possibleHeads.some(head => mergedHeads.has(head)) matching (lines 647-654) then fills mergedPrIssues unchanged. Keep open-candidate scoping (only issues with issueOpen true are queried; state comes from the tracker lens for GitLab projects). Tests mirror the issue's Verification section: stale unmerged branch + merged MR -> hasMergedPr true -> post_merge_limbo (open) / clean_terminal (closed), never planned_backlog; merged MR only in the api repo while the ref was observed in fe -> still hasMergedPr (FR-3 union); repos with forge 'github' in the same polyrepo are never queried (FR-4); merged-MR lookup skipped for closed candidates; rejecting dep -> forge_unavailable (FR-6).

items.title: Given an open issue with a stale unmerged convention branch whose head the dep reports merged, when gatherProjectLensSignals runs, then the issue yields hasMergedPr: true and resolvePipelineMembership produces post_merge_limbo — never planned_backlog
Given a closed issue in the same merged-MR setup, when the resolver classifies it, then it produces clean_terminal
Given the merged MR is returned only by the api repo's dep while the branch ref was observed in fe, when the gather runs, then the issue still yields hasMergedPr: true (polyrepo union)
Given a polyrepo containing a github-forge repo, when the gather runs, then mock call inspection shows that repo's path is never passed to listMergedMergeRequestHeads or listOpenMergeRequests
When the injected listMergedMergeRequestHeads dep rejects, gatherProjectLensSignals rejects with reason 'forge_unavailable'
Document the GitLab MR lenses in docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md

expected_outputs: the doc names src/lib/gitlab-merge-requests.ts and both GitLab lens behaviors

narrative.Action: Update docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md in two places. (1) Durable-lenses section: replace the closing capability-gating sentence ('Pull-request lenses are capability-gated: projects without github_repo still gather tracker state…') with the new three-tier behavior — GitHub projects use gh/GraphQL lenses; GitLab projects use the glab-backed per-repo lenses from src/lib/gitlab-merge-requests.ts (open + merged MRs, union across gitlab-forge repos); only projects with neither forge configured fall back to tracker/branch/spec lenses. (2) Read-doors section: add one sentence naming src/lib/gitlab-merge-requests.ts as the GitLab MR read path used by the gather, noting the 30s TTL cache and the per-head exact-query rationale (an arbitrarily old squash-merge must never paginate away).
